name: יִשְׁפָּן
summary: Ishpan appears in the genealogy of Benjamin among the sons of Shashak.

evidence.note: The list names Ishpan between Eliel and Eber.
The closing words identify this group as the sons of Shashak.

note: The name has an initial yod before the consonants of Shaphan. Its formation and meaning are uncertain.
